zh.title: 手机端可靠性、Android 品牌图标与 Kimi 稳定性
items: Android 图标升级为完整的 adaptive、round 与 Android 13 主题图标，并加入统一的 Deep Night 品牌启动页。
手机端长会话首次打开、切换会话和通知进入时直接定位最新消息；用户上翻阅读时不会被新消息强制拉回底部。
文字和图片附件按会话保存草稿，发送失败或拒绝后原样保留；不支持的图片、读取失败和大小超限会给出明确提示。
手动输入配对链接可即时识别，不可打开的 Agent 不再显示误导入口，设备页显示真实安装版本和通知后台边界。
Kimi Code 新增 12 类固定 ACP 契约场景，修复历史分片合并、事件顺序、旧工具状态、断线审批和分页边界。
新增每两小时安全构建心跳：门禁通过后生成不可覆盖的签名 Android 候选包，但不自动覆盖 OSS 或生产版本。

en.title: Mobile reliability, Android brand icons, and Kimi stability
items: Android now ships complete adaptive, round, and Android 13 themed icons, plus a consistent Deep Night branded launch screen.
Long mobile conversations open at the latest message after entry, session switches, and notifications; new messages no longer steal position while the user reads older history.
Text and image drafts are preserved per session and survive rejected or failed sends; unsupported files, read failures, and size limits now produce visible feedback.

Manually entered pairing links are recognized immediately, non-openable Agents no longer expose misleading navigation, and Device shows the installed version and honest notification background limits.
Kimi Code adds 12 deterministic ACP contract scenarios and fixes history coalescing, event ordering, stale tool state, disconnected approvals, and pagination boundaries.
A safe two-hour build heartbeat now archives non-overwriting signed Android candidates after all gates pass, without automatically replacing OSS or production releases.
